name: VR Soualiga
summary:
VR Soualiga is an immersive journey into the past of St. Maarten, the island its first people called Soualiga, the "Land of Salt."

Your lesson begins in a classroom of the future. When your teacher opens the way, you step out of the present and into the island's story:

- The Great House: wander a grand island estate set among banana trees, green hills and warm Caribbean light.
